Hair turns grey `when your hair follicles stop producing melanin` , the pigment that gives hair its natural color.[[1]](https://www.aad.org/public/everyday-care/hair-scalp-care/hair/gray-hair-causes)[[2]](https://joshwoodcolour.com/blogs/community/what-actually-causes-grey-hair-here-s-what-the-experts-have-to-say)

### Main Causes of Gray Hair

- **Genetics:** Your family history is the most important factor in determining when you will start going grey and how fast it happens.[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226)[[2]](https://www.joyoushealth.com/the-truth-about-gray-hair-causes-and-natural-ways-to-slow-it-down/)
- **Natural Aging:** As you get older, the melanocyte stem cells in your hair follicles naturally slow down or die off, producing less pigment over time.[[1]](https://www.joyoushealth.com/the-truth-about-gray-hair-causes-and-natural-ways-to-slow-it-down/)[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greying_of_hair)
- **Chronic Stress:** High stress levels can trigger oxidative damage and rapid hair shedding (telogen effluvium), which can speed up the grey-growth process.[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226)[[2]](https://www.joyoushealth.com/the-truth-about-gray-hair-causes-and-natural-ways-to-slow-it-down/)
- **Nutritional Gaps:** Low levels of essential nutrients—such as **vitamin B12, iron, copper, and vitamin D** —can interfere with normal pigment production.[[1]](https://www.facebook.com/DrDorisDay/videos/hair-turns-grey-for-so-many-reasons-grey-or-white-hair-in-and-of-itself-is-not-a/762708776074280/)[[2]](https://www.joyoushealth.com/the-truth-about-gray-hair-causes-and-natural-ways-to-slow-it-down/)
- **Smoking:** Cigarette smoke creates oxidative stress and is strongly linked to premature graying before age 30.[[1]](https://us.davines.com/blogs/news/what-causes-gray-hair)
- **Medical Conditions:** Issues like **thyroid disorders** or autoimmune conditions (such as vitiligo or alopecia areata) can impact your pigment cells.[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/DrDorisDay/videos/hair-turns-grey-for-so-many-reasons-grey-or-white-hair-in-and-of-itself-is-not-a/762708776074280/)

You can read more about the biological breakdown on the [Cleveland Clinic Gray Hair Guide](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/why-hair-turns-gray) or the [Harvard Health Publishing Overview](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226).[[1]](https://www.health.harvard.edu/blog/hair-turn-gray-2017091812226)[[2]](https://health.clevelandclinic.org/why-hair-turns-gray)If you'd like to narrow down what might be happening, tell me:

- **How old are you** , and when did the greying start?
- Are you noticing other symptoms like **fatigue, hair thinning, or stress**?

items.title: The Truth About Why Hair Goes Grey (Most People Get This ...
What people are saying
The reason hair turns white is more complex than aging alone.

Going gray early is not just cosmetic, and it is not always genetic. Your hair color comes from pigment cells at the root of every follicle, and those cells are extremely sensitive to oxidative stress. When your body is short on the raw materials it needs or overwhelmed with inflammation, hydrogen peroxide builds up in the follicle faster than you can clear it, and that quietly shuts down pigment production from the inside.

That is why I pay less attention to the gray itself and more to what it is pointing at. Low B12, low copper, low ferritin, and a sluggish thyroid all show up as early graying long before they show up as anything a standard panel flags. Most labs will call your levels normal when they are sitting at the very bottom of the range, which is exactly where symptoms like this begin.
